title: refactor(auth): derive the org-role vocabulary from @objectstack/spec instead of mirroring it
body:
Closes #2908 — the follow-up #2907 recorded as blocked. All three unblock conditions now hold:

1. ✅ The vocabulary is closed (framework ADR-0108, objectstack-ai/objectstack#3802).
2. ✅ `@object-ui/auth` now depends on `@objectstack/spec` (this PR, `^17.0.0-rc.0` like every other package).
3. ✅ The constants are published: `@objectstack/spec@17.0.0-rc.0` on npm ships `BUILTIN_MEMBERSHIP_ROLES` / `MEMBERSHIP_ROLE_*`, verified against the installed dist. The `^16 → ^17` sequencing wrinkle the issue flagged resolved itself when the workspace moved to `^17.0.0-rc.0`.

## What changed

- The four `ORG_ROLE_*` consts are now rename-re-exports of the spec's `MEMBERSHIP_ROLE_*` literals; `OrgRole` = `BuiltinMembershipRole`; `ORG_ROLES` = `[...BUILTIN_MEMBERSHIP_ROLES]` (the spec array is already in the display order the screens use — verified identical values and order at runtime).
- **Kept local, per the issue:** `ORG_ROLE_LABELS` and the grade ladder (`orgRoleGrade`, `invitableOrgRoles`, `assignableOrgRoles`) — console concerns (i18n keys, screen-narrowing), per ADR-0108 D4.
- Dropped #2907's drift guard (`is EXACTLY the framework four`) — a derived list cannot drift. The #2891 `toContain(delegated_admin)` test stays, reframed: it pins a console decision (`ORG_ROLES` is the spec list *unfiltered*), which types don't enforce.
- Public API of `@object-ui/auth` is unchanged (same names, same literal types); `app-shell` consumers type-check untouched.

## Verification

- `vitest run packages/auth` — 8 files, 106 tests pass
- `@object-ui/auth` + `@object-ui/app-shell` type-check pass; lint 0 errors (no new warnings)
- Lockfile: no second spec instance / `zod@3` peer-variant fork (`grep -c "zod@3.25.76))" pnpm-lock.yaml` → 0)
- Runtime: `BUILTIN_MEMBERSHIP_ROLES` = `["owner","admin","delegated_admin","member"]` from the installed package
